title: Small & Micro Wedding Venues in Dallas, With Prices
description: 10 small and micro wedding venues in Dallas, $250 to $2,500, each price from the venue's own site. Checked Oct 28, 2026.
h1: Small & micro wedding venues in Dallas
eyebrow: Dallas · prices from the venues' own pages
answer_html:
As of Oct 28, 2026, 10 small and micro wedding venues in Dallas print their own prices, from $250 (Blush Event Garden - 'Essential' sign-and-go elopement) to $2,500 (The Penrose House: DIY elopement). For a group of 10 or more, the lowest is $450 (Blush Event Garden - 'Classic' elopement).

Each price and guest count is quoted from the venue's own website and shows the day we read it.

faq.q: What is a normal cost for a wedding venue in Dallas?
faq.a: We do not quote an average, because an average hides what each venue actually prints. On this page 10 venues print prices from $250 to $2,500, each quoted from its own website on Oct 28, 2026.

faq.q: What are some cheap wedding venues in Dallas under $1,000?
faq.a: 7 of the 10 venues print a price under $1,000: Blush Event Garden - 'Essential' sign-and-go elopement $250; Blush Event Garden - 'Classic' elopement $450; Skip The Courthouse Chapel: She Said Yes $550; Bouré Event Studio $600. Prices are for the package or hours each venue names, so read the row before you book.

faq.q: What is a small wedding considered?
faq.a: There is no official cutoff, so we use each venue's own words: the guest limits printed on this page run from 2 to 75 people. Every venue here prints its price for a small, micro, weekday or elopement booking.

faq.q: How much does a micro wedding cost in Dallas?
faq.a: The venue prices we verified run $250 to $2,500. Add the sample finds on this page (a $250 dress, $400 photos) to the cheapest venue and you get about $900 before catering, rings and tax.

faq.q: Is $5,000 enough for a wedding in Dallas?
faq.a: For a small group it can be: the cheapest verified venue ($250) plus the sample finds comes to about $900, and even the most expensive venue here is $2,500. A 100-guest wedding is a different budget, because this page prices small groups only.
